name: novochar
description: Novochar (নভোচার) — interactive sky viewer and time-series blink comparator for candidate TNOs, asteroids and high proper-motion stars across SPHEREx survey passes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run check:spherex-bundle && npm run precompute:data && npm run build -w client
scripts.sidecar:setup: python3 -m venv sidecar/.venv && sidecar/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r sidecar/requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run check:data && npm run check:spherex-bundle && npm test -w shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w client
